items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: I was at Millenburg with me, Willard Dennis Boyd. What's that piano player's name? Louis Gallo.

ctx.x: Were there still things going? Do you remember Harold too? Were there... Was there much going on out in the book?

No, there wasn't much going on out there. Our dad, uh, around the depression. You came with me after Eddie Jones and that. After, yeah. But I was at Millenburg before he went there. You see, I was at Millenburg with me, Willard Dennis Boyd. What's that piano player's name? Louis Gallo. Louis Gallo, yeah. And Bill, you see. And then, uh, Bill, uh, then after we left there, then we made, uh, we made a band, and me and Willard Dennis Boyd, then we used to go play out there also. When, uh, around 1929, 30, like that…
Yeah, cause Wickwood used to play at Varaday. I'm like Varaday there. Varaday. Hickman and them. Hickman and them.
